## Deliverable

GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME carries the judge-path row(s) for the relayed-429 no-strike rule: a judge's `wrong-verdict` reported on a session whose last relayed upstream answer was a 429 still counts a model-scoped strike, proven by a `rule("GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME")` case so the gate sees what today is prose only.

## Acceptance

1. `gateway/specs/endpoints/sessions.md` §GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME (the store table that carries "a consumer outcome after a relayed 429 strikes nothing ⚖", shipped to master by the Goal #3118 assembly PR #3270) gains the two rows below; `gateway/tests/test_sessions_outcome.py` proves each as a `rule("GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME")`-labelled case naming its world, green.
2. Removing the judge exemption from the 429 gate in `outcomes.py` (the `not judge` term PR #3125 describes) turns row 1 red — the prose judgment is now a proven row.
3. The spec-join and hygiene ratchets do not rise; the prose sentence "A judge's outcome (`wrong-verdict`) is on the verdict, not the ride, and still counts" stays beside the rule and the rows prove it.

## Spec changes

Requirement: `GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME` on `gateway/specs/endpoints/sessions.md` — world `policy-enforce · upstream-429` (the judge is a fixture caller of the enforce world; the fake upstream answers 429).

| description | world | sequence | strikes? | series? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "a judge's wrong-verdict after a relayed 429 still strikes ⚖" | policy-enforce · upstream-429 | the worker session's request answered `upstream-429`, then the judge reports `wrong-verdict` | `{…, wrong-verdict, model, outcome}` | `{class="wrong-verdict",source="outcome"}` 1 |
| "two reporters on one 429'd session: the consumer's unknown strikes nothing, the judge's wrong-verdict counts ⚖" | policy-enforce · upstream-429 | `upstream-429`, the platform loop reports `unknown`, then the judge reports `wrong-verdict` | one strike `{…, wrong-verdict, model, outcome}`; `GET` → `outcome.class` = `wrong-verdict` (the judge's outcome supersedes on GET, §When) | `{class="wrong-verdict",source="outcome"} 1`, `{class="unknown",source="outcome"} 0` |

Index row: none — no `⚑ gap` flag carries this; the shortfall is a prose judgment without a row.

Unverified (verify during implementation): that the enforce world's fixture composes with the `upstream-429` fake-upstream behaviour for the worker session (the existing 429 rows ride `policy-default`); the strike cell literal is whatever cell the enforce world's worker session rides. The table these rows join is the one the assembly #3270 lands on master — master's sessions page is in the v0.6.9 row shape (PR #3188) while the goal branch's is not, so take the header from master after the merge.

## Out of scope

- The canary-ride exemption from the same gate (`not row.canary_provider`, pinned by `test_strike_after_429_not_the_verdict` under GW-CATALOG-OR's 2026-10-22 ruling) — changing it is an operator ruling, not this row.
- The `⚑ gap: the fleet view` row on GW-SESSIONS-OUTCOME.

Origin: finding from the PR #3125 review, deferred by the Goal #3118 checkpoint (entry 1) as outside the Goal's acceptance; a sprout of child #3119. Body rewritten by island intake 2026-11-12 into the queue-ready shape; the original is in the edit history.
